channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Timothe Luwawu | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Timothe Luwawu from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JJ Redick on John Hammond, Russell Westbrook, Alvin Gentry, Tobias Harris, Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Timothe Luwawu, Josh Hart
item.description:
Redick:

“In my little circle of T.J. McConnell, Doug McDermott, Tobias Harris and Josh Hart, it was usually me. But Josh has got some great Bordeaux in his collection. But he also had some shipped in. The last night I was there, I didn’t have enough room in my luggage to transport all of the wine back home to New York. So I brought six or seven bottles to the Grand Floridian hotel. I had a little wine meal with Timothé Luwawu-Cabarrot, Russell Westbrook, Doug, TJ and myself. Then (former Pelicans coach) Alvin Gentry and (Orlando Magic general manager) John Hammond happened to be sitting at the table next to us. So I shared a couple of sips with them.”

JJ Redick on John Hammond, Russell Westbrook, Alvin Gentry, Tobias Harris, Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Timothe Luwawu, Josh Hart, Sep 21, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Jim Boylen on Timothe Luwawu
item.description:
Jim Boylen on Timothe Luwawu-Cabarrot, who will meet team in Chicago:

“He’s got a scorer’s mentality to him, has good size. He’s a wing I’m glad we can take a look at and see what he can do.”

Jim Boylen on Timothe Luwawu, Feb 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Timothe Luwawu
item.description:
Erik Horne:Billy Donovan on Timothe Luwawu-Cabarrot:

“Tim was a professional guy. I think for any young player who’s out of the rotation it’s hard. It can be challenging because every guy wants to get out there. But he always handled himself well, worked hard to always keep himself ready.”

Billy Donovan on Timothe Luwawu, Feb 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.
